title: Temporal execution state
description: Queryable graph data from committed Temporal state. Fields describe the retained execution projection, not workflow inputs or arbitrary database tables.

identityFields.description: Namespace UUID shared by every node in this source.
Workflow ID, or execution ID for a standalone activity.
Exact execution run ID. Combine with namespace_id and workflow_id to identify a run.

nodes.label: Workflow
nodes.description: Current retained workflow execution state. Each committed replacement updates the same run's node.

fields.description: Registered workflow type.
Workflow task queue.
Internal execution state. Use data.status for workflow outcomes.
Workflow execution status. These case-sensitive strings differ from protobuf enum names.

Time the execution closed.
First run in this execution chain.
Previous run in a continued execution chain, when known.

Base run associated with a reset.

Workflow creation request identity, useful for correlating Watch-originated starts.

nodes.label: Activity
nodes.description: Current retained workflow activity or standalone activity state. Removed activities are not reconstructed from older history.

nodes.label: Timer
nodes.description: A retained workflow timer. Reusing a timer ID does not reuse its graph identity.

fields.description: User-supplied timer ID.
History event ID that identifies this timer instance.
Committed timer deadline, when available.
FIRE_BUFFERED is not a finalized firing. A committed Fact with transition FIRED records the finalized firing.

nodes.label: Fact
nodes.description: A committed lifecycle transition, distinct from current retained state. Facts can describe transitions that do not have a separate History event.

fields.description: Entity category whose transition was committed.
Entity ID within the execution.
Activity scheduled event ID, when applicable.
Activity attempt, when applicable.
Committed transition, such as STARTED, COMPLETED, FAILED or FIRED.
History event ID if the transition has a finalized History event.
Transition time.
Failure category without messages, details or payloads.
Timeout category. An unspecified timeout is omitted.

relationships.label: HAS_ACTIVITY
relationships.description: Links a workflow to a retained workflow activity. Standalone activities have no workflow-owner edge.

relationships.label: HAS_TIMER
relationships.description: Links a workflow to a retained timer.

SearchAttribute.description: Each entry in data.search_attributes contains a declared type and a decoded JSON value.

fields.description: Declared Temporal search attribute type.
Decoded value of the declared type. Large integers retain integer precision in the native graph.

notes: Identity fields are directly on each node. Entity-specific fields are nested under data, for example w.workflow_id and w.data.status.
Enum strings are case-sensitive Go String() values, not protobuf JSON names. A completed workflow has data.status = 'Completed'.
date-time fields contain RFC3339 timestamps. Optional fields may be absent; omission is not an empty string, false or a fabricated value.
This source contains committed state, not uncommitted changes or raw History payloads. Workflow inputs/results, activity inputs/results, failure details and heartbeat contents are excluded.
The projection is scoped to the current namespace and retained executions. It is not a global atomic snapshot or a transaction shared with an external database.
A connector configuration schema describes connection settings. It is not the graph-data schema described here.
